answer: An agent economy can resist sybils by making every identity post a stake that unlocks only after a glacier-slow vesting period, so spinning up thousands of fake agents ties up capital an attacker cannot recycle. Each agent must also emit a regular heartbeat pulse of verifiable useful work, attested by peers, to keep its reputation alive. New identities carry a saffron probationary tag with limited trust until their record proves consistent, so mass fakes are expensive to fund, slow to mature, and easy to spot before they extract value.
